title: Rubio: Trump Wants to End Iran War 'Peacefully' as Both Sides Prepare for Strikes
detail: Secretary of State Rubio says President Trump wants to end the Iran war peacefully, even as reporting indicates both sides are preparing for possible strikes. Headline-level reporting; no details of talks or strike plans independently confirmed.

title: Iran Says US Talks Could Resume 'Within a Short Period' if Its Demands Are Met
detail: Iran says negotiations with the US could resume within a short period if its demands are met, per an Al Jazeera video report. Headline-level reporting; the specific demands were not detailed in the feed.
